correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed every essential claim with code paths distinct from the submitted verifier. (1) Matroid: exhaustive basis-exchange over the 68 claimed bases returns True; rank function gives no 1<=k<=7 separator (seps=[]), so connected; with nonbases exactly two disjoint 4-sets, every 3-set is independent and the dual has the same nonbasis pair, so sparse-paving holds. (2) Realization: exact Fraction elimination over all C(8,4)=70 minors gives zeros exactly on {1234,5678} and nonzero elsewhere; archived minor_table.csv matches Fraction recomputation on all 70/70 values (an initial Bareiss cross-check showed 6 sign mismatches solely because that script omitted row-swap sign bookkeeping; corrected Fraction and permutation-expansion paths agree 70/70, including 2356=-1). Rank is 4. (3) Dressian: all 420 three-term relations (2-set base x complement quadruple) satisfy min-attained-twice, independently recomputed. (4) Subdivision: cells C0 (68 bases), C1/C2 (nonbasis + 16 neighbors each, sizes 68/17/17) satisfy exact supporting-plane equalities (z=0; |S cap 1234|-3; |S cap 5678|-3) with strict inequality off-cell, affine dimension 7 each, cover all 70 vertices, C1 cap C2 empty, and C1/C2 satisfy basis exchange. (5) Valued lift: independent permutation-expansion determinant polynomials for A(t)=A+t(E41+E15) give valuation 1 on the two nonbases (det1234(t)=-22t, det5678(t)=-18t, cofactors nonzero) and 0 on all 68 bases (0/70 mismatches). Hence trop(A(t))=h exactly, so h lies in Trop Gr(4,8) and, inducing exactly the certified subdivision, in the relative interior of its own Dressian secondary cone. Submitted verifier prints ALL_CHECKS_PASS, reproduced. Proof vs evidence: claims rest on exact integer/Fraction arithmetic, not floating point or heuristic search.
